heading: Sunday Night
text: Scattered showers or a thunderstorm spreading into Vermont early then reaching NH around midnight, and tapering off northwest, giving way to partial clearing. Lows in the 50s. Winds west near 10 mph, becoming light and variable in wind-sheltered valleys.

heading: Monday
text: Fog and a few passing morning showers, and becoming mostly sunny south. Breezy and cool. Highs in the 60s north, to near 70 south. Northwest winds increase to around 10, over 15 around Lake Champlain, gusting to 25 mph.

heading: Monday Night
text: Mostly clear and chilly. Areas of dense river valley fog. Lows in the 40s, with a few 30s in the colder mountain valleys. Calm winds.
